calculation.description: Ranks assets by efficient 20-day recovery/trend: cumulative return divided by realized absolute-return path length, mildly penalized when price remains below its 60-day high. Higher values indicate smoother recoveries and stronger continuation potential.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC was positive in 2020-2022 (0.047345), 2023-2024 (0.016378), 2025-2026 (0.036553), and 2027-2028 (0.013850), but negative in 2029 YTD (-0.055734); use conservative weight and monitor drift.
validation.deprecation_reason: Failed benchmark daily paper IC admission gate: absolute daily IC 0.003482 < 0.0070, despite positive 10-day IC/ICIR.
